source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the date and time of the inspection.
3. Record the address, name, and details of the building, including the type (residential, commercial, etc.)
4. Document the inspector’s name, title, agency, and contact information.
5. Use a standardized checklist to note each aspect of the fire-safety inspection, specifying what items were checked.
6. Clearly mark each failed item with a "Fail" label or similar clear mark to make them stand out.
7. For each failed item, provide a detailed description of why it failed, including compliance standards that were not met.
8. Use photos or videos to substantiate the failures. Include the date, time, and location tags on these media files.
9. Record any immediate hazards found during the inspection, and whether they require an emergency action.
10. Document any discussions with the property owner, manager, or occupant regarding the failed items, including any immediate mitigation efforts.
11
